title: letlotlo le le nweletseng ka fa tlase ga boikgogomoso
intro: Akanya fela o eme fa pele ga dithotobolo tsa khumo tse dintsi thata jaana mo e leng gore go rwala dinotlolo fela go ne go tla lapisa setlhopha sa batho ba ba nonofileng. Go go dikologa, mantswe a rotloetsa boikokobetso le go gakologelwa, le fa go ntse jalo boikgogomoso bo gola go feta tebogo. Go diragalang fa bopelotshweu bo nna teko mme boikgogomoso bo tshwaya phelelo?
clues: Ke ne ke tswa mo bathong ba ga Musa, le fa go ntse jalo ke ne ka ba tlolela molato.
Ke ne ka newa matlotlo a magolo thata jaana mo e leng gore dinotlolo tsa one di ne di tla imetsa setlhopha sa banna ba ba nonofileng.
Ke ne ka gakololwa ke batho ba me gore ke se ka ka itumela le go batla Morago ga Loso ke sa lebale kabelo ya me ya lefatshe leno.
Ke ne ke bolela gore se ke neng ke na le sone ke se neilwe fela ka ntlha ya kitso e ke neng ke na le yone.
Ke ne ke tsamaya fa pele ga batho ba me ke ikgabisa, mme ba ba eletsang botshelo jwa lefatshe ba ne ba eletsa se se tshwanang le se ke neng ke na le sone.
Ke ne ka mediwa ke lefatshe mmogo le bonno jwa me, mme ga go ope yo o neng a ka nthusa le fa e le nna ke ne ke sa kgone go ithusa.

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: O ne a ipelafatsa ka khumo mme a gana kamogelo ya ga Allah le fa a ne a gakololwa
O gwetlhile Ibrahim ka ga go naya botshelo le loso
O ne a etelela pele mophato kgatlhanong le Talut le Dawud
Medingwana e e betlilweng gore batho ba e obamele
O bolaile morwarraagwe ka ntlha ya go fufegela tshupelo
trial.answer: O ne a ipelafatsa ka khumo mme a gana kamogelo ya ga Allah le fa a ne a gakololwa

location.label: Elemente ya Botlhokwa

Letlole la Kgolagano
Namane ya gauta ya mekgabiso

outcome.label: Botso
options: Go mediwa ke lefatshe ka bonno le khumo .
O nwetse mo lewatleng fa a ntse a latelela Musa
O iteilwe ke letlapa le le tswang mo seatleng sa ga Dawud
E sentswe ke go thunya go go maatla ka ntlha ya go kgaola kamela e namagadi
Ba fetogile ditshwene ka ntlha ya go tlola Sabata
outcome.answer: Go mediwa ke lefatshe ka bonno le khumo .

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
